front.zh: 現代俳句 & 變奏   系列《15》

en: Distant where the text does not circle

points.zh: 德弗札克 ( Antonin Leopold Dvorak,  1841-1904 ) 是捷克最偉大的作曲家。1891年受邀到美國紐約擔任國民音樂院院長，因緣際會，創作了備受歡迎和肯定的第九號交響曲「 From the New World 」。台灣樂界稱之為「新世界交響曲」。此交響曲融合了捷克波西米亞旋律，美國民謠和黑人靈歌，極富旋律性，令人難忘。其中第二樂章是緩板，也是大家熟悉的「念故鄉」，旋律如泣如訴，感人肺腑。第四樂章則是燦爛華麗的奏鳴曲，呈現出火焰般的快板，樂曲齊奏，有如千軍萬馬奔騰，讓人震撼，感動不已。
points.en: Antonin Leopold Dvorak (1841-1904) was the greatest Czech composer. In 1891, he was invited to New York, USA, as the president of the National Conservatory, where he composed the popular and affirmed Ninth Symphony "From the New World". Taiwanese music circles call it the New World Symphony. This symphony is a melodic and unforgettable blend of Czech bohemian melodies, American folk songs, and black spiritual songs. The second movement is a slow board, and it is also a familiar "nostalgic hometown". The melody is sobbing and moving. The fourth movement is a brilliant and gorgeous sonata, showing a flaming fast board. The music is played together, like a thousand armies and horses rushing, which is shocking and moving.

en: A glass of wine, ten years of lights
You have your rivers and lakes

points.zh:
我居北海君南海，寄雁傳書謝不能。
 桃李春風一杯酒，江湖夜雨十年燈。
 持家但有四立壁，治病不蕲三折肱。
 想見讀書頭已白，隔溪猿哭瘴溪藤。
--北宋。黄庭堅 《寄黄几復》

zh: 從一個海灣到下一個海灣
en: Pacing the deck, foggy and wet
from one bay to the next.
Let's go back down the flower path.
I have something on my mind
A poem written for you when you were young
Like smoke, floating in front of you

points.zh:
《 光陰的故事 》
詞  / 曲 :    羅大佑
發黃的相片，古老的信
以及，褪色的聖誕卡 
年輕時為你寫的歌
恐怕你早已忘了吧 
過去的誓言，就像
那課本裡繽紛的書籤 
刻畫著多少美麗的詩
可是，終究是一陣煙 
流水它帶走光陰的故事
改變了兩個人 
就在那多愁善感
而初次流淚的青春
